# EXIF Tag

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ExifTag`](gmeow-ExifTag.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ExifTag>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified EXIF metadata tag of a media object — a tag identifier ([`gmeow:exifTagId`](../properties/gmeow-exifTagId.md), e.g. 'FNumber'), its value ([`gmeow:exifTagValue`](../properties/gmeow-exifTagValue.md), e.g. 'f/2.0'), and a human-readable label ([rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label), e.g. 'Aperture'). The [schema:PropertyValue](https://schema.org/PropertyValue) shape: reification keeps each tag's id/value/label paired correctly and lets an OPEN, camera-defined EXIF set round-trip losslessly to [schema:exifData.](https://schema.org/exifData.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ExifTag`](gmeow-ExifTag.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
